address: 84 Biesterfield Rd, Elk Grove Village, IL 60007

reviews.text: One of the best sushi places I have been to in a long time; must-stop when in the area; sushi is fresh and clean.
Delivery lunch came hot, well-presented, generous portions and fresh ingredients; Boston roll favorite; generous ginger/wasabi.
Gorgeous restaurant with delicious food; decor and atmosphere lovely; service friendly and efficient; vegetarian and gluten-free options.
Nigiri and sushi are amazing, very fresh with nice cuts; some specialty roll flavor/texture caveats.
Outstanding experience; food fresh, flavorful and beautifully presented; staff attentive and friendly.
Favorite sushi around here; recommends Sweetheart, Volcano and Alaska rolls; notes evenings can get busy.
Fantastic experience with spacious seating, well-paced service and phenomenal food.
Cocktails, appetizers, sushi and rolls were all good; going back again.
Amazingly warm atmosphere, delicious food and best service; definitely coming back.
Picky sushi eater calls it a gem close to home; usually pickup but enjoyed dine-in; praised food, atmosphere and service.
New favorite sushi place; Godzilla Roll, Volcano Roll and Spicy Crispy Tuna Roll all 5/5; service amazing.
Outstanding, elegant Japanese restaurant; delicious fresh sushi and amazing ramen bowls; worth driving to.
High-quality sushi near home; server friendly/helpful/professional; sashimi and teriyaki salmon praised.
Very good place for rolls and sushi; lunch menu with two rolls, four nigiri, soup and salad; friendly service and cozy decor.
Presentation and intention in every roll outstanding; food, service, ambiance and price top notch.
A must for sushi and sashimi cravings; staff friendly and accommodating.
Second visit; fell in love with the place; welcoming atmosphere.
Hidden gem; sashimi utmost quality and fresh; dishes beautifully presented; impeccable service; chic modern pleasant atmosphere.
Group of five loved it; some of the best sushi in the area; staff friendly and attentive.
Food, service and ambiance wonderful; sashimi and sushi rolls fresh and beautifully presented; steak ramen and tempura praised.
Sushi restaurant Elk Grove Village needed; amazing food, beautiful presentation, friendly attentive staff.
Dinner with friends; soup, appetizers and main course fresh and delicious; lunch menu also excellent.
Found via online search; presentation amazing; staff friendly; twins spicy roll and regular sashimi both amazing.
Great sushi and sashimi; staff friendly and fast; decor stylish and upscale; strong bar menu.
Probably the best sushi the reviewer and fiancé ever had; ordered too much compared with home portions.
Everything perfect; best sushi ever; helpful attentive friendly wait staff; clean, modern and trendy space.
One of the best sushi restaurants; wonderful staff, incredible food and reasonable prices.
Consistently very good food and servers; pickup packaged with care; online ordering easy to navigate.
Great place to eat; peaceful atmosphere for solo dining or date; quick respectful service; tonkatsu shio ramen praised.
Expected basic takeout but found one of the nicest sushi restaurants in the suburbs; fresh food, excellent presentation, great atmosphere.
